name: Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited
summary: Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited operates a multispecialty hospital and its satellite centers in India. It operates through two segments, Healthcare Services and Education Services. The company offers outpatient and inpatient medical services in the fields of cardiology, cardiac anesthesiology, cardiovascular and thoracic surgery, comprehensive cancer center, critical care medicine, dentistry/faciomaxillary surgery, dermatology and cosmetic dermatology, electrophysiology, emergency services, endocrinology and diabetology, ENT/head and neck, fertility and reproductive medicine, gastroenterology and hepatology, general/laparoscopic surgery, hematology, internal medicine, interventiona…
